lastCompletedStory.title: Implementer agent: patterns.md grep-on-demand, drop AGENTS.md ref and CLAUDE.md re-read

nextStoryContext: US-003 (planner agent) should drop journal.md and integral patterns.md from Project Context, and remove AGENTS.md refs there too — reuse the same wording patterns landed here: 'grep-on-demand, not a full read; grep for the section/keywords matching the subsystem this story touches and read only the matching bullets' for patterns.md, and the auto-load note ('scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md auto-loads via Claude Code's nested-CLAUDE.md mechanism: it is already in context before you start, so do not re-read it') wherever a mandate to re-read scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md appears. Both .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md and templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md were edited (dual-copy is per-file specialization, not byte-identical — .claude's copy has extra 'use the Read tool' mandate language in its Inputs-read-order step 4 that the templates copy lacks; preserved both as-is). The 'append a bullet to patterns.md' post-implementation flow and the Layer A behavioral-gate section were left untouched (out of this story's scope). Remember to run `bun run embed-vendor` after any templates/ edit, then `bun run embed-vendor:check`.
